title: Webinar
description: Landscape webinar card in the house look: the title big, the speaker's photo, name and role beside it, and the date, time and registration link (placeholders until they're set). Source: https://www.joinmassive.com/blog/is-robots-txt-legally-binding (the default topic, by Franklin Uche, Community Lead).

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: One or two words: Webinar, Live session

fields.label: Title
fields.hint: Up to three lines; about 40 characters reads best

fields.label: Date
fields.hint: e.g. Thu, November 12. Leave the brackets until it's known

fields.label: Time and time zone
fields.hint: e.g. 5 pm CET / 11 am ET. Leave the brackets until it's known

fields.label: Registration link
fields.hint: A short link without https://, about 30 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known
